tha-ap271:1.1: Upāgatabhāsaniya.] Himavantassa vemajjhe saro āsi sunimmito / tatthāhaṃ rakkhaso āsiṃ poṭṭhasīso bhayānako. // //
tha-ap271:2.1: Anukampako kāruṇiko Vipassī lokanāyako / mam uddharitukāmo so āgacchi mama santike. // // Upāgataṃ
tha-ap271:3.1: mahāvīraṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ / āsayā abhinikkhamma avandiṃ satthuno ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap271:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ vandiṃ purisuttamaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vandanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap271:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Upāgatabhāsaniyo thero i. g. a-ti.
